#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class Graph {
    int vNum;
    int src;
    int sink;

    int** res;
    int** cost;
    std::vector<struct Edge> costGraph;
    std::vector<int> p;
    std::vector<int> d;

    struct Edge {
        int from;
        int to;
        int cost;
        Edge(int f, int t, int c): from(f), to(t), cost(c) {}
    };

public:
    int getVertexNumber() {
        return vNum;
    }

    Graph(int vCount, int s, int t): vNum(vCount), src(s), sink(t) {
        res = new int*[vNum];
        cost = new int*[vNum];
        for (int i = 0; i < vNum; ++i) {
            res[i] = new int[vNum]{};
            cost[i] = new int[vNum]{};
        }
        costGraph.reserve(vNum * vNum);
        d.resize(vNum);
        p.resize(vNum);
    }
    ~Graph() {
        for (int i = 0; i < vNum; ++i) {
            delete[] res[i];
            delete[] cost[i];
        }
        delete[] res;
        delete[] cost;
    }

    void addEdge(int from, int to, int capacity, int cst) {
        res[from][to] += capacity;
        cost[from][to] = cst;
        cost[to][from] = -cst;
    }

private:
    bool findCheapestPath() {
        costGraph.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < vNum; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < vNum; ++j) {
                if (res[i][j] > 0) {
                    costGraph.emplace_back(i, j, cost[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        std::fill(d.begin(), d.end(), INT_MAX);
        std::fill(p.begin(), p.end(), -1);

        d[src] = 0;
        bool changed = false;

        for (int i = 0; i < vNum - 1; ++i) {
            changed = false;
            for (const auto& e : costGraph) {
                if (d[e.from] != INT_MAX && d[e.from] + e.cost < d[e.to]) {
                    d[e.to] = d[e.from] + e.cost;
                    p[e.to] = e.from;
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
            if (!changed) break;
        }
        return p[sink] != -1;
    }

    std::vector<int> augmentPath(int from, int to, int flow) {
        int pathCost = 0;
        for (int cur = to; cur != from; cur = p[cur]) {
            flow = std::min(flow, res[p[cur]][cur]);
        }
        for (int cur = to; cur != from; cur = p[cur]) {
            res[p[cur]][cur] -= flow;
            res[cur][p[cur]] += flow;
            pathCost += cost[p[cur]][cur] * flow;
        }
        return {flow, pathCost};
    }

public:
    std::vector<int> getMinCostMaxFlow() {
        int flow = 0;
        int totalCost = 0;
        while (findCheapestPath()) {
            auto result = augmentPath(src, sink, INT_MAX);
            flow += result[0];
            totalCost += result[1];
        }
        return {flow, totalCost};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n; cin >> n;
    string s; cin >> s;
    int letters = 26;
    vector<int> letCount(letters, 0);
    for (char c : s) letCount[c - 'a']++;
    vector<int> b(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> b[i];

    int source = 0;
    int charOffSet = 1;
    int pairOffSet = charOffSet + letters;
    int sinkOffSet = pairOffSet + n / 2;
    int sink = sinkOffSet;
    int vNum = sinkOffSet + 1;

    Graph g(vNum, source, sink);

    for (int i = 0; i < letters; ++i) {
        g.addEdge(source, charOffSet + i, letCount[i], 0);
        for (int j = 0; j < n/2; ++j) {
            char c1 = s[j];
            char c2 = s[n - j - 1];
            if (c1 == 'a' + i) {
                if (c1 == c2) {
                    g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -max(b[j], b[n - j - 1]));
                } else {
                    g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -b[j]);
                }
            } else if (c2 == 'a' + i) {
                g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -b[n - j - 1]);
            } else {
                g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, 0);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n/2; ++i) {
        g.addEdge(pairOffSet + i, sink, 2, 0);
    }

    std::vector<int> ans = g.getMinCostMaxFlow();
    std::cout << -ans[1] << "\n";

    return 0;
}
